title: Shoulder arthroscopy
what: The surgeon looks inside the shoulder joint with a camera through a few small openings. A tendon can be repaired, extra tissue removed, or the joint stabilized at the same time.
why: For torn shoulder tendons, dislocations, or severe pain and stiffness, when other treatment has not helped.
duration: surgery usually takes 1 to 2 hours; usually 1 to 2 days in hospital, or home the same day
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to stop and when
Allergies to medicines, latex, or iodine
Heart or lung disease, or diabetes
Past dislocations or injuries of this shoulder
What work you do and what you need to lift

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and sometimes a GP checkup. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthetist
prepare.text: Before surgery, an anesthetist will talk with you. Tell them about your health and medicines.

prepare.title: Food and water
prepare.text: Usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Clothes
prepare.text: A button-up shirt or top. You will not be able to pull things over your head at first.

prepare.title: Home
prepare.text: Your arm will be in a sling for the first weeks. Think about who can help with chores.

bring: Your referral, MRI scans, and test results
An arm sling, if you were told to buy one
steps: On the day, you change, and an IV line is placed
Often the arm is numbed with a shot near the neck, and general anesthesia is given
You are positioned half sitting or on your side
The surgeon makes a few small openings and inserts a camera
The joint is examined, and the needed repair is done
The openings are stitched, and the arm is placed in a sling
feel: The arm may be numb for a few hours. That is from the numbing
Then the shoulder hurts. You will get painkillers
Sleeping half sitting up is more comfortable at first
after: The sling is usually worn from a few days to 4 to 6 weeks. Your surgeon will say
Start exercises on your doctor's plan, not on your own
Keep the dressing dry until you are told it is OK
Full recovery often takes several months
red_flags: A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), or redness and pus from the openings
The arm is very swollen, or your fingers are cold or blue
Sudden shortness of breath or chest pain: call emergency services

faq.q: Why does recovery take so long?
faq.a: A repaired tendon takes several months to grow back onto the bone. So it is important not to overload the arm too soon.

faq.q: How do I sleep with a sore shoulder?
faq.a: Many people find it easier half sitting, with a pillow under the arm. Ask your doctor what is best for you.

reminders.text: Shoulder arthroscopy tomorrow. Bring your scans and a button-up shirt. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
